hazards.control: Hearing protection at the power pack, flare, and choke house.

name: Power pack
function: The diesel-driven hydraulic power unit that supplies the injector, reel, stripper, and BOP functions.

tabs.overview: Sized to the injector motors; accumulators on the BOP circuit so rams close with the engine stopped.
tabs.engineering: Hydraulic pressure and flow per the injector.
tabs.safety: Hot exhaust and hydraulic lines; noise.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
